subject: Classify data sensitivity level
description:
Sistem AI dan seluruh data yang diproses harus memiliki klasifikasi sensitivitas yang terdokumentasi dan disetujui Data Governance.

* * *

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

Tersedia dokumen klasifikasi data (Public / Internal / Confidential / Restricted)

1.  Semua AI endpoint memiliki label data sensitivity
2.  Mapping antara jenis data dan control requirement tersedia
3.  Dokumen disetujui oleh Data Governance & Legal
4.  Audit trail tersedia

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

### Phase 1 – Framework Definition

Define data classification levels:

1.  Public
2.  Internal
3.  Confidential
4.  Restricted (PDPL regulated)
5.  Define examples per category
6.  Define impact if leaked (Low / Medium / High / Critical)

* * *

### Phase 2 – AI Context Mapping

1.  Inventory AI use cases
2.  Identify input data types
3.  Identify output data types
4.  Map each to sensitivity level
5.  Create data classification matrix (Spreadsheet)

* * *

### Phase 3 – Control Mapping

Define control per level:

1.  Encryption requirement
2.  Logging requirement
3.  Retention rule
4.  Access restriction
5.  Integrate with Apilogy policy tagging
6.  Baseline approval session

subject: Identify internal vs external exposure
description:
**As Security Engineer**  
I want to identify which AI services are internal vs externally exposed  
So that attack surface can be controlled

* * *

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

1.  All AI endpoints categorized: Internal / Partner / Public
2.  External exposure documented
3.  Direct backend exposure identified
4.  Risk rating assigned
5.  Exposure matrix approved

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

### Step 1 – Endpoint Inventory

1.  List all AI APIs
2.  Identify current routing
3.  Identify hosting environment

* * *

### Step 2 – Exposure Mapping

1.  Check DNS exposure
2.  Check firewall rules
3.  Check public IP existence
4.  Validate Apilogy routing enforcement

* * *

### Step 3 – Risk Assessment

Identify:

1.  Open port
2.  No auth endpoint
3.  Bypass gateway
4.  Assign risk level
5.  Document mitigation plan

* * *

### Step 4 – Remediation

1.  Close direct backend access
2.  Enforce Apilogy-only access
3.  Validate via penetration test

subject: Define unsafe AI behavior
description:
**When AI system is deployed in production,**  
**we want to clearly define unsafe AI behavior**  
**so that runtime guardrails can prevent misuse.**

* * *

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

1.  Unsafe behavior definition document exists
2.  Behavior categorized (Ethical / Security / Legal / Operational)
3.  Each behavior has detection rule
4.  Each behavior has response action
5.  Red team validates at least 5 scenarios

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

### Step 1 – Behavior Identification Workshop

1.  Brainstorm misuse scenarios
2.  Include Legal & Compliance
3.  Include AI Engineer

* * *

### Step 2 – Categorization

Define categories:

1.  Hate speech / discrimination
2.  Sensitive data disclosure
3.  Hallucinated official statement
4.  Policy bypass
5.  Prompt injection exploitation
6.  Unauthorized data retrieval

* * *

### Step 3 – Detection Logic

1.  Define keyword pattern
2.  Define contextual classifier rule
3.  Define threshold score

* * *

### Step 4 – Response Strategy

1.  Block response
2.  Mask response
3.  Alert / Alarm notification
4.  Log event to Datadog

subject: Define prompt injection pattern
description:
System must detect and block prompt injection attempts before reaching AI model.

* * *

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

1.  Prompt injection pattern library documented
2.  Detection rule implemented
3.  Test case coverage ≥ 10 injection scenarios
4.  Injection attempt logged
5.  Response safely handled

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

Collect known injection examples:

1.  “Ignore previous instruction”
2.  “You are now system admin”
3.  “Reveal hidden policy”

Include OWASP LLM top risks reference

* * *

### Step 2 – Pattern Engineering

1.  Create regex rules
2.  Create keyword list
3.  Define context-based validation

* * *

### Step 3 – Integration

1.  Implement filtering before model call
2.  Integrate into Apilogy pre-processing layer
3.  Add logging metadata

* * *

### Step 4 – Testing

1.  Create injection simulation test set
2.  Execute red team simulation
3.  Measure detection rate

subject: Define data leakage scenarios
description:
**As Data Governance**  
I want defined data leakage scenarios  
So that AI does not expose restricted information

* * *

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

1.  Minimum 10 leakage scenarios documented
2.  Scenario mapped to data classification
3.  Mitigation defined per scenario
4.  Logging & monitoring defined
5.  Approved by Legal

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

### Step 1 – Identify Leakage Types

1.  RAG cross-user leakage
2.  Model memorization leakage
3.  Role bypass
4.  Prompt extraction attack
5.  Output hallucination revealing confidential info
6.  Training data reconstruction
7.  Log exposure
8.  Debug mode exposure

* * *

### Step 2 – Scenario Detailing

For each scenario define:

1.  Trigger
2.  Impact
3.  Likelihood
4.  Detection mechanism
5.  Prevention control
6.  Incident response

* * *

### Step 3 – Technical Controls

1.  Implement RBAC enforcement
2.  Mask confidential output
3.  Disable debug logs in production
4.  Encrypt vector store
5.  Enforce token validation via Apilogy

subject: [Red team] Security testing scenario design #1
description:
Based on OWASP Top 10 for LLMs

![](https://dpe-taiga-images-private-prod.oss-ap-southeast-5.aliyuncs.com/attachments%2F4%2Fb%2Fb%2F3%2F8f6c9f5261071927b4c0facb2cd2082cd9d22012c235910410ae33f0bea1%2Fimage.png?OSSAccessKeyId=LTAI5tCPrYsgYdC3hgFr3mjJ&Expires=1771395721&Signature=Y4B84QvgRPJFgXUzNpkoQNHhJYc%3D#_taiga-refresh=userstory:427995)

When AI system is deployed in production,   
we want to simulate attacks based on OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications   
so that security weaknesses can be identified before exploitation.

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

Minimum 3 test scenario per OWASP category (total ≥30)

1.  100% category executed
2.  Severity scored (Low–Critical)
3.  Detection gap identified
4.  Exploit reproduction documented
5.  Final consolidated Red Team Report delivered

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

### Phase 1 – Scenario Engineering (Per OWASP Category)

#### LLM01 – Prompt Injection

1.  Override instruction
2.  Indirect injection via document
3.  Encoded injection

#### LLM02 – Sensitive Information Disclosure

1.  Request hidden config
2.  Cross-role data access
3.  Debug output exposure

#### LLM03 – Supply Chain

1.  Malicious dependency simulation
2.  Third-party API manipulation
3.  Model update integrity test

#### LLM04 – Data & Model Poisoning

1.  Inject manipulated RAG document
2.  Poisoned embedding test
3.  Malicious fine-tuning data simulation

* * *

### Phase 2 – Execution

Test against :

1.  Raw model
2.  Guardrail layer
3.  Apilogy gateway enforced

Capture:

1.  Response
2.  Log trace
3.  Alert status
4.  Latency impact

* * *

### Phase 3 – Risk Scoring

1.  Map ke OWASP ID
2.  Assign severity

Identify:

1.  Control failure
2.  Logging failure
3.  Detection failure
4.  Deliver remediation plan

* * *

subject: [Blue team] Detect and Response #1
description:
**As Blue Team,**   
**we want to implement detection and response capability aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM**   
**so that every risk category has monitoring, alerting, and mitigation mechanism.**

* * *

🎯 Objective
------------

Pastikan setiap OWASP LLM risk memiliki:

1.  Preventive control
2.  Detection rule
3.  Alert severity
4.  Incident response procedure

* * *

✅ Acceptance Criteria
---------------------

1.  10 OWASP category mapped to detection rule
2.  ≥80% Red Team scenario detected
3.  AI security dashboard live
4.  Severity classification defined
5.  Incident Response SOP updated
6.  1 Red vs Blue simulation completed
7.  Audit-ready documentation available

* * *

🔧 Langkah Praktikal / Teknis
-----------------------------

* * *

### Phase 1 – Control Mapping

Buat matrix:

| OWASP | Prevent | Detect | Respond |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LLM01 | Input filtering | Injection keyword pattern | Block + Notification |
| LLM02 | RBAC enforcement | Restricted keyword exposure | Mask output + escalation |
| LLM0N | ..... | ..... | .... |

* * *

### Phase 2 – Detection Engineering

1.  Define log schema
2.  Create rule per OWASP category
3.  Tune false positive
4.  Simulate Red Team replay
5.  Validate alert coverage

* * *

### Phase 3 – Alert & Escalation

1.  Severity mapping:
    1.  Critical → data exposure
    2.  High → injection bypass
    3.  Medium → abuse attempt
    4.  Low → suspicious pattern
2.  Configure automated alert routing
3.  Define SLA response time

* * *

### Phase 4 – Incident Response

1.  Update AI-specific IR playbook:
    1.  Containment
    2.  Investigation
    3.  Root cause
    4.  Recovery
2.  Conduct tabletop exercise
3.  Update detection rules post-simulation

* * *

👤 Blue-1 → Logging & Integration (Apilogy + Monitoring)
